items.message: `base_url()` falls back to `self._settings.base_url` when the client attribute is absent, which means a proxy in `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` that the SDK absorbed before the fix could still slip through if `_client.base_url` is falsy for any reason.
Gemini's `base_url` is set to `""` (empty string) when `gemini_endpoint` is `None`, which is the shape `register` now refuses for `endpoint`.
